preconditions.description: The jumble input must be a string.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(dictionary, list) and all(isinstance(w, str) for w in dictionary)
preconditions.description: The dictionary input must be a list of strings.

postconditions.expression: all(word in dictionary for word in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every word in the returned list must exist in the input dictionary.

postconditions.expression: all(sorted(word) == sorted(jumble) for word in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every word in the returned list must be an anagram of the jumble (same letters with same counts).

postconditions.expression: all(return_value.index(dictionary[i]) < return_value.index(dictionary[j]) for i, j in [(i, j) for i in range(len(dictionary)) for j in range(i+1, len(dictionary)) if dictionary[i] in return_value and dictionary[j] in return_value])
postconditions.description: The returned words must appear in the same relative order as they do in the input dictionary.

postconditions.expression: return_value == [word for word in dictionary if sorted(word) == sorted(jumble)]
postconditions.description: The returned list contains exactly all words from the dictionary that are anagrams of the jumble, preserving dictionary order.
